name: Data Quality
description: Assess whether the dataset is trustworthy enough for the requested analysis.
plan_rules: Confirm the unit of analysis before interpreting anomalies.
Report rates as well as counts.
Separate invalid values from acceptable sparsity.
validation_rules: Do not silently drop rows or impute values.
Tie each issue to an analytical risk.

name: Aggregation and Ranking
description: Compute totals, averages, shares, grouped comparisons, and top or bottom rankings.
plan_rules: Identify the measure, aggregation, grouping dimensions, and filters explicitly.
State whether nulls are excluded by the aggregation.
Use deterministic tie handling for rankings.
validation_rules: Verify grouped values reconcile to the requested total when applicable.
Verify the sort direction and requested N.

name: Time Series and Cohort
description: Analyze trends, period comparisons, retention, and cohort behavior.
plan_rules: Define the time field, timezone assumption, analysis window, and grain.
Exclude incomplete periods unless the user explicitly requests them.
For cohorts, define both the entry event and return event.
validation_rules: Check that dates were parsed successfully.
Do not compare partial periods with complete periods without warning.
Use eligible cohorts only in retention denominators.

name: Metric Diagnostics
description: Explain why a business metric moved by checking definition, baseline, segments, and contribution.
plan_rules: Confirm the metric definition and comparison baseline first.
Rule out measurement artifacts before business explanations.
validation_rules: Contributions should reconcile to total movement when additive.
Label observations, hypotheses, and unknowns separately.
Do not claim causality from descriptive data.
